title: VALORANT Patch Notes 13.05
text: TLDR; Pick’ Ems for Champs, penalties for stream sniping and instalock tools, and future changes to the Agent Gear system so make sure to grind it out and get all the items now! Heyo, it’s Ash and we’ve got a small-ish patch for you with mostly bug fixes. We’re prepping for a pretty beefy next patch in 13.06 so more to come! Let’s get it. ALL PLATFORMS COSMETICS UPDATES Sound Sprays Based on your feedback, we've adjusted the sound attenuation for all sound sprays so you'll only be able to hear the sounds if you're nearby to ensure teams can communicate effectively. This will be a standard for all future audio sprays. ESPORTS FEATURES Pick’Ems have returned for Champions Shanghai ! Starting on September 10, you will have access to the Group Stage in-client and on the web. Predict the advancing teams for points, earning extra points for correctly guessing the exact placement. You’ll also earn rewards just for participating. Get your picks in before Groups kickoff on September 24th! PLAYER BEHAVIOR UPDATES We've started rolling out penalties if we detect usage of stream sniping and instalock tools. Players found using these tools will be subject to temporary game bans that will escalate to permanent with repeated usage. PROGRESSION UPDATES Agent Gear Heads up, gamers! With the release of Patch 13.06 on September 22, we'll be revamping the Agent Gear system and the way you unlock items on that progression track. You will still keep the gear you've already earned, and you'll continue to use Kingdom Credits to unlock future gear. But after Patch 13.06, each piece of gear will be tied directly to how much you play the associated Agent. So if you're currently grinding for Agent Gear on any Agents you don't usually play, now's your chance to lock in and get those unlocks. BUG FIXES Agent General Fixed an issue where Agent Ultimate voiceover could continue playing from an enemy's perspective after the Agent casting the Ultimate was killed. Fixed an issue where the Combat Report incorrectly displayed "Enemies Blinded" for certain abilities that don't apply Blind. Fixed an issue where smokes would block flashes after dissipating. We’ve better timed the dissipation for the smokes on Astra, Brimstone, Clove, Miks, and Omen to fix an issue where their smokes could continue blocking flashes and other line-of-sight-dependent abilities while the smoke was dissipating. Chamber Fixed an issue that could cause performance drops the first time Chamber equipped, aimed, or fired Headhunter during a round. Cypher Fixed an issue where Cypher's Trapwire debuff could persist indefinitely on a new target if the initial target was killed just before the Trapwire triggered. Fixed an issue where Cypher's Cyber Cage could incorrectly block flashes, detection, and other line-of-sight-dependent abilities. Deadlock Fixed an issue where casting Deadlock's GravNet could briefly display unintended VFX on screen. Fade Fixed an issue where Fade's Seize would not display its danger indicator to enemies in certain locations on Lotus. KAY/O Fixed an issue where KAY/O's NULL/cmd could cause client-side framerate drops with each pulse. Omen Fixed an issue where Omen’s Dark Cover could obscure a player’s vision after the smoke has dissipated. Sage Fixed an issue where Sage's Healing Orb ability tooltips could be missing from the HUD when equipping the ability. Waylay Fixed an issue where vision-blocking abilities could prevent Waylay's Saturate from applying Hinder to players within its area of effect. Fixed an issue where Waylay's Refract could cause snapshots of dynamic map objects to remain visible after the ability ended. Fixed an issue where Waylay's Saturate could apply Hinder to Agents while they were intangible. PC ONLY GENERAL UPDATES Default Bot Count in Range Practice Mode An option for 10, 5, or 1 bot to spawn has been added in the Range practice mode. The default number of bots spawned is now 5. You can adjust this number in the Range settings. Fixed an issue where the close button was not functional after purchasing VALORANT Points.

title: Apex Legends™: Marked Midseason Patch Notes
text: Table of Contents Legend Buffs Conduit Fuse Catalyst Bloodhound Legend Nerfs Axle Seer Loot & Attachments Loot Spawning Weapons Attachments Locked Hop-Ups Maps Wildcard Ranked Audio Bug Fixes Legends Weapons Maps Engine Audio Quality of Life INTRO Welcome back to Split 2 of Apex Legends: Marked. To start the second half of the season, we’ve got Legend balancing changes, some adjustment to loot availability (including more healing items), buffs to a trio of long range weapons, and the usual array of tweaks, fixes and adjustments. Split 2 starts on September 15th, so assemble your squad and get ready to jump back into Marked! ANTI CHEAT UPDATE In the leadup to Split 2, we implemented significant, new systems to detect players using unauthorized controller hardware or software in Apex Legends on all platforms including: PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2. Prior to implementation, we spent several months thoroughly validating these systems to ensure they can accurately identify prohibited behavior. Players that trigger these detections will be actioned upon and may be banned accordingly upon review. Playing on console does not make you exempt from detection or enforcement. This is just the beginning for these new systems which we will continue to improve to keep pace with evolving cheating methods. We want the community to know that we are actively working to identify and remove cheaters at every level of play — including the highest ranks. Thank you to everyone who reports suspicious behavior and helps us keep Apex Legends fair. For more anti-cheat information, check out our most recent update ! PATCH NOTES LEGEND BUFFS Conduit Dev note: Our main goal is to give Conduit players more avenues for skill expression and to ensure her abilities feel functional, readable, and fluid. Apex’s Shield Healer saw a big uptick in her success throughout Season 29 thanks to some overhauls to her Tactical and its associated upgrades. Despite Conduit receiving a few nerfs since then, we still wanted to come back to her this Season to focus on polishing and refining her Ultimate, as mentioned in the Season 29 Designer’s Notes. Beyond her base kit, we wanted to give Conduit two brand new Level 2 Upgrades that are now fully unique to her and emphasize different aspects of her aggressive support style. Tactical Added preview visuals on the shield bar to indicate how much Temp Shield will be generated by the end of the regen period. Ultimate Various aspects of the Ultimate’s deployment have been smoothed out, meaning it fires faster and gets you back to guns sooner. Can now toggle orientation while targeting to deploy jammers in a forward line. Added a new HUD element to better inform players if their deployment location will cause jammers to break. Also, individual jammer indicators now turn red if they would break at the current targeting location. Jammers now spawn higher and slightly closer together, creating a tighter formation that covers more vertical space. Jammers activate significantly faster, establishing the barricade’s threat area quicker. Upgrades Both Level 2 Upgrades, Battpack and Bigger Jam, have been removed. NEW: Concurrency (Level 2) Refire Energy Barricade once with no cooldown within 10s of initial firing. Jammers spawn in a tighter formation with 2 less jammers. NEW: Jammed Up (Level 2) Energy Barricade’s jammers have a 25% larger radius and enemies damaged by them have their HUD jammed for 10s. Fuse Dev note: Though this grenadier has seen a gradual increase in play over time since his rework in Season 28, we wanted to revisit him to address the community feedback that we didn’t hit the efficacy, impact, and responsiveness expected of a new Motherlode. We’re also making some big shakeups to his Upgrade configuration that impact the rest of his kit, including incorporating Wreckless and Knuckle Cluster into his base kit (with some nerfs). Rest assured, we’ll be keeping a close eye on him, as our intention is to add more hype tech to Fuse’s toolbox without pushing him toward being a Legend defined by his movement. He will always be Apex’s explosives expert first and foremost! Passive Added 25% Explosive Damage Resistance at base and can see ordinances highlighted in the world within 30m of him. Tactical Fuse can now Knuckle Jump at base. Jumping no longer provides Tactical cooldown reduction. Jump power moderately decreased, so Fuse will gain less momentum when jumping. Now displays a visual indicator that signifies the radius where the jump can be activated. Significantly decreased the time it takes to return to guns after firing. Players can now ADS while aiming to zoom. Ultimate Slightly decreased the raise time. Adjusted the firing arc with the focus on the main explosive projectile landing more quickly and responsively. Added an indicator to visualize the radius of the initial and subsequent explosions. Decreased the time it takes for the mini-bombs to explode, speeding up the rollout of explosions. Decreased the damage falloff on the initial explosion, meaning enemies closer to the edge of the radius will take a higher percentage of the maximum damage. Upgrades Knuckle Jumper (Level 2) and Wreckless (Level 3) have been removed. Reignition has been moved from Level 3 to Level 2. Pyro Techniques (Level 2) Doubled the radius of the persistent flames. Reignition (Level 2) Decreased Ultimate Recharge Rate from 1s per 2 explosive damage to 1s per 3 explosive damage. NEW: Big Bang (Level 3) Knuckle Cluster’s explosions cover a 50% larger area. NEW: Sticky Bomb (Level 3) Knuckle Cluster’s initial projectile is 25% larger and sticks to enemies. Every 7 hits on an enemy reduces Knuckle Cluster’s cooldown by 1s. Catalyst Dev note: Catalyst saw a small boost in pick rate after her buffs in Season 28, but we felt she needed more love using a slightly different approach since her stats didn’t hold. This Season, we’re focusing more holistically on smoothing out the tension of moving from base to base amongst the fast pace of action. We want Cat’s building experience to be fun and flexible, so giving her more options to customize her space and adding in some longtime community-requested quality-of-life features will empower players to feel rewarded for putting in the work to master her. We’re also making big swings on shuffling up her upgrades, including a new Level 3 upgrade, Ferro-Frenzy, that will really shake up how we see players approach their setup. Passive Catalyst is no longer immune to other Catalysts’ abilities. Tactical Now automatically reinforces or rebuilds doors if colliding with a valid door or doorway on placement. Decreased Cooldown from 20s to 15s. Increased Spike Height, meaning that players can less easily jump over them. Hitting enemies with the projectile will now deal damage to them. Ultimate Significantly decreased firing time, making it smoother to deploy and raise the wall. Allies are no longer slowed or blinded when passing through the wall. Upgrades Sole Piercer (Level 2) has been removed. Hidden Spikes has been moved from Level 2 to Level 3. Resilient Veil and Ferro-Door have been moved from Level 3 to Level 2. Ferro-Door (Level 2) Now also increases max reinforced doors from 4 to 6. Resilient Veil (Level 2) Now also decreases Ultimate Cooldown from 150s to 120s. NEW: Ferro-Frenzy (Level 3) Your max Spike count is increased by 1. Spikes are 50% smaller, but deal faster tick damage. Bloodhound Dev note: Bloodhound got some significant changes for this season but they haven’t been as impactful on their pick and encounter win rates as we hoped. With these updates we’re hoping to add some improvements to their Ultimate and Tactical. We’ll continue to monitor Bloodhound’s performance and adjust if needed. From 8/‌25 Hotfix: Ultimate Reduced cloak visibility while in dome. Ring damage no longer drops cloak. Tactical Added 1 extra second on scan length. Tweaked to provide more frequent snapshots, but the snapshots fade over time. New: Tactical Sonar snapshots begin fading more quickly. Sonar snapshots should disappear more readily when seeing the head of either the snapshot or the player being tracked. Back to Top LEGEND NERFS Axle Dev note: For an ability with a short cooldown that can have a devastating effect on one target, the Kickstart drone needs more counterplay options. Even when the victim decides to destroy the drone, the high health pool often makes that hard to do, especially in close quarters when Axle is quickly following up, herself. For cases when destroying it isn’t an option, at least the victim should be able to have more agency about where they get displaced with the knockback nerf and decreased stun. From 8/‌25 Hotfix: Tactical Nitro Gate launch speed reduced from 750 to 700. Ultimate Ultimate HP reduced from 200 to 150. Base Ultimate cooldown increased from 90s to 120s. Ultimate knockback arc widened and max height reduced. Ultimate stun duration reduced from 1.5s to 0.25s. Upgrades Jump Gate replaced with a new Drone Deployer Upgrade that brings the Ult cooldown back down to 90s. Seer Dev note: The turn slow punishment on the Seer tactical was very frustrating to fight against. We’ve decided to remove the turn slow since the tactical output is still strong without it. From 8/‌25 Hotfix: Removed turn slow when hit by the Tactical Back to Top LOOT & ATTACHMENTS LOOT SPAWNING Dev Note: Last season, we made a huge change to loot distribution and spawning (read our retrospective in this update’s designer’s notes!). After reviewing the data and feedback from the community, we are making some minor adjustments to healing, ammo, and weapon availability. Healing was becoming scarcer than intended, and due to the removal of energy ammo, the other ammo types were spawning ammo boxes at higher rates than intended. Bin Resets have been adjusted to be closer to its pre-Season 30 version but keeps the original intent of reducing its overall spike to player power. The Season 30 version was not providing the density of necessities needed to quickly re-stock for the end game. Reset Bins now have more items on average with healing, ammo, survival slot items, and amps spawning more frequently inside. The Weapon Assist feature previously only included a small selection of pistols, shotguns and the Alternator. To help players find higher quality weapons off the drop, we are expanding this to now include all available weapons. These adjustments help to address some of the pain points we have been seeing while maintaining the overall goal of last update’s changes of creating an overall healthier loot curve as the game progresses. We will continue to monitor your feedback and make adjustments as quickly as we can! Loot Pool Spawn Rates (Pre-Bin Reset) Increased availability of healing items. Slightly decreased availability of ammo. Loot Bin Reset Increased average count of items spawned per bin Increased availability of: Healing Ammo Survival Slot items Amps Loot Bin Logic Updated loot bin logic to significantly reduce the possibility of empty loot bins spawning in game. The weapon pool for Weapon Assist (opening your first loot bin of the match while having no weapons in your inventory) now has the chance to spawn all base weapons. Previously could only spawn a selection of pistols, shotguns, and the Alternator. WEAPONS Dev Note: Season 30 was a large shakeup to the weapon meta and we want to let things settle a bit more before making any big changes. We are buffing a few weapons that were previously falling behind and have continued to fall after Season 30. Triple Take Increased rate of fire while in ADS. Blue magazine increased from 8 to 9. Bocek Compound Bow Increased arrow stockpile from 40 to 60. Increased explosive arrows per energize from 7 to 10. Adjusted Sparrow’s Quiver accordingly: Increased arrow stockpile from 50 to 70. Increased explosive arrows per energize from 9 to 12. Charge Rifle Increased max distance damage from 99 to 110. Max damage occurs at >200m. Decreased selectfire damage penalty from 40% to 25%. ATTACHMENTS Dev Note: Mach 1 Gibby was really funny, but unintentional. Now, both he and Maggie should move as intended with their respective movement speed buffs and the Agile Standard Stock. (Previously Hotfixed) Agile Standard Stock [Corrupted] The movement speed increase no longer stacks with: Maggie's Warlord's Ire passive Maggie's Gunrunning legend upgrade Gibraltar's Fast Shotties legend upgrade LOCKED HOP-UPS Dev note: Heavy hitting shotguns can be inconsistent with their damage, either with chunky hits or lots of 11s. As such, it can be more difficult to unlock their respective hop-ups when compared to a full auto-weapon. Thus we are lowering the cost to unlock. Executioner Reduced cost to unlock from 375 to 275. Back to Top MAPS Dev note: In this patch, we’re rolling out over 150 map-related Quality of Life fixes across the Outlands with a massive chunk of that polish going straight to World’s Edge. We’ve smoothed out sticky collisions to keep wall-bouncing and rotations fluid, patched up geo holes that were occasionally swallowing loot and Legends, and permanently closed off several unintended rat spots to maintain competitive integrity. Alongside these tweaks we’ve also cleaned up some clipping issues related to Alter’s Ultimate. Massive shoutout to our community for continuing to report these back to the team. Finding every hole, ledge or rat spot across the Outlands is a huge undertaking and the clips and bug reports you share are exactly what helps us track them down. Your feedback directly shapes the map health of Apex so keep sharing your clips. Pubs Map Rotation World’s Edge Olympus Broken Moon Ranked Map Rotation World’s Edge Olympus Broken Moon Mixtape 9/‌15/26 - 11/‌3/26 TDM: Fragment, Skull Town, Monument, Estates Control: Production Yard, Labs, Barometer, Caustic Gun Run: Monument, Estates, Fragment, Skull Town Back to Top WILDCARD Wildcard Updates EVO gained when no weapons are equipped will now grant that EVO towards progression on the first weapon you equip. Map Rotation Kings Canyon Wildcard Olympus Wildcard District Wildcard Back to Top RANKED Ranked Ladders (coming later this split) Ladder 1 9/‌22/‌2026 9/‌27/‌2026 Ladder 2 9/‌29/‌2026 10/‌4/‌2026 Ladder 3 10/‌6/‌2026 10/‌11/‌2026 Ladder 4 10/‌13/‌2026 10/‌18/‌2026 Ladder 5 10/‌20/‌2026 10/‌25/‌2026 Ladder 6 10/‌27/‌2026 11/‌1/‌2026 Back to Top AUDIO Dev note: We understand how crucial game audio can be to the outcome of a fight or match. With new chatty weapon skins in the Cyberpunk collab, we wanted to make sure we provided you with more control over these audio options. Added a new audio menu option to toggle weapon dialogue on/off. It will appear if you own a talking weapon skin Dev note: We have received community reports pointing to a few interior spaces that were abnormally loud (particularly in Olympus and E-District). Thank you, and please continue sending us your feedback. Resolved an issue resulting in abnormally loud audio in interior spaces on Olympus and E-District Back to Top BUG FIXES Mixtape: Smoke trails (from effects like Valk’s Ult) now match the color of your squad (for example, orange for Tiger Squad). Previously, every squad’s smoke trail was a slightly different shade of blue. Respawn from Deathbox: Fixed an issue where players could get persistent Infinite Ammo after being respawned. Fixed an issue where players could activate Respawn from Deathbox from behind a wall. Fixed an issue where Locked Hop-Ups would not always grant the correct point value after respawning. LEGEND BUG FIXES Bloodhound: Fixed a bug with True Predator where the timer UI would not show up in certain situations where you were uncloaked but eligible to re-cloak. Bloodhound: Fixed some issues where the Allies Cloaked stat tracker was counting improperly. Catalyst: Fixed Hidden Spikes not revealing themselves after applying a slow to an enemy that did not have line of sight to the core. Catalyst: Fixed being unable to pick up Piercing Spikes from range after they had been activated, then deactivated. Catalyst: Fixed several Friendly Fire interactions in the Firing Range. Catalyst: Fixed Piercing Spikes not affecting Firing Range Dummies. Conduit: Fixed Energy Barricade repeatedly applying overlapping third-person VFX to enemies who took successive damage hits. Fuse: Fixed Fuse being able to Knuckle Jump while in phase. Fuse: Fixed Knuckle Jumping toward the end of the jump window causing a loss of momentum. Fuse: Fixed The Motherlode not dispersing smoke and gas. Fuse: Fixed Pyro Techniques not dealing damage to enemies that stood still in the center flames. Fuse: Fixed Pyro Techniques not dealing damage to Mirage decoys. Fuse: Fixed The Motherlode’s initial projectile passing through enemies when fired at a breachable surface while in breach mode. Wattson: Fixed Fuse’s The Motherlode not being intercepted by Interception Pylon. WEAPON BUG FIXES P2020: Fixed a bug where the Tactical Laser sight would not properly reduce the recoil control. MAPS BUG FIXES World’s Edge East Village: Fixed a hole in terrain where players could hide. East Village: Added and adjusted some cover. Monument/Fragment: Restored missing railings on the bottom level of construction stacks. Sorting Factory: Fixed a bug where players could clip into the moving crates using an Alter portal. Fixed inconsistent behavior with vertical ziplines at East Village, Tree Settlement and Sorting Factory. ENGINE Fixed bug with cloak rendering on consoles and PC with TSAA enabled, making it consistent for all visual options. Fixed bug where joining another player's party could sometimes fail and leave you stuck in a zero-player party. AUDIO BUG FIXES Fixed missing footstep audio during 3rd person movement when using Sparrow’s Hunt Target upgrade. Fixed overly loud interior spaces in Olympus and District. QUALITY OF LIFE Valkyrie: Improved the responsiveness of the enemy targeting while skydiving. Back to Top Play Apex Legends for free * now on PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox® One, Xbox® Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and PC via the EA app, Epic, and Steam. title: S11 Version Patch Notes | The 2nd Anniversary Season "Reorientation" is about to begin!
text: Dear Operators, We plan to launch a non-stop update for PC, mobile, and console versions on September 8, opening the new season "Reorientation"! PC UPDATE CADENCE At 08:30 UTC+8 on September 8, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed. At 09:59 UTC+8 on September 8, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled. At 10:00 UTC+8 on September 8, the PC update will be available. MOBILE UPDATE CADENCE At 08:30 UTC+8 on September 8, Operations and Warfare ranked matches will be off-season and temporarily closed. At 09:59 UTC+8 on September 8, the Operations entrance and matchmaking mode will be closed, and the Market and Auction House functions will be disabled. At 10:00 UTC+8 on September 8, the Android and iOS updates will be available. THE MAIN CONTENTS OF THE NEW SEASON ARE AS FOLLOWS: New Support Operator - Rover; Operations map refresh: Layali Grove; New Operations mode - Fishing; New Space City mode: Chieftain's Road - Polaris Patrol; New Warfare map: The Mog; brand-new 1v1 mode; new weapons, new ammo, plus extensive optimizations and balance adjustments! Full details on this season's update are below. Dive in! NEW SUPPORT OPERATOR: ROWAN WALSH, CODENAME ROVER MAN'S BEST FRIEND Blows the dog whistle to call in a military dog that fights alongside the operator. The dog continuously senses enemy targets within range: if enemies are present, it locks onto the nearest target and actively pursues, tackling them and applying a Mark; if no enemies are detected, it follows the operator and remains on Alert. DART RIFLE (OPERATIONS) Fires syringes. Upon impact, each syringe releases a lingering mist that continuously heals allies' injured limbs while reducing the max HP of enemies within range and dealing damage over time. DART RIFLE (WARFARE) Fires syringes. Upon impact, each syringe releases a lingering mist that reduces the max HP of enemies within range and deals damage over time. IRRITANT Throws an Irritant Smoke Grenade; enemies within the smoke will cough. GUARD DRIVE (OPERATIONS) Enemies hit by his gadgets become easier for his military dog to track. Grants longer downed durations, and rescuing an ally removes multiple stacks of limb injuries. PREY DRIVE (OPERATIONS) Enemies hit by his gadget become easier for his military dog to track. Rescuing an ally resupplies their ammo. MAP UPDATES OPERATIONS MAP REFRESH - LAYALI GROVE 2.0 Scene Changes: Added Serenity Bay, North Slope Caves, and the Haavk Underground Dock, among other areas; Expanded the map boundaries, and optimized and connected the overall river network; Adjusted cover structures in certain areas. Mode Update: Added a new Flagship Task, "Bounty: Wave Breaker": steal and escort an Assault Boat hidden in the Haavk Underground Dock for Reis, then extract it for rewards; the Assault Boat remains usable after the mission is complete; Added a new vehicle gameplay feature: in addition to the Assault Boat, four Jet Skis have been added to the map, drivable across all river areas on the map; when "Bounty: Wave Breaker" is not active, two additional Jet Skis will spawn; Added a new NPC gameplay feature: encounter new NPCs "Joe Reed," "Zola Zar," and "Taj Faris" on the map. Interact with them, and unexpected stories may unfold. Other Optimizations: Redesigned and adjusted the Insertion Point locations at Layali Grove; Removed the blocked-off area inside Haavk WSR Lab. Adjusted the extraction rules for the train extraction point at Transnova Station: the door opens 1 minute after pulling the lever, with extraction available 3 minutes later (previously 5 minutes); Added new supply containers and supply spawn points; Due to the map scene upgrade, optimized and adjusted the distribution of certain supplies; Optimized and adjusted unbalanced positions on the map. NEW WARFARE MAP - THE MOG Event Description: The brand-new map "The Mog" has arrived! Return to a classic, smoke-filled battlefield and wage intense infantry street warfare through the crumbling districts of modern Mogadishu! Experience all-new push-cart tug-of-war battles and UH-60 Black Hawk suppressive air support, and launch epic combined-arms map warfare. NEW MODES POLARIS PATROL Mode available starting: October 16 Gameplay: In Polaris Patrol mode, choose to play as either Desmoulins or the Adjutant. After selecting your identity, your appearance and abilities will switch accordingly. Upon entering a match, your role switches to Desmoulins or the Adjutant, granting you all-new abilities to fight off the invaders. Squad Desmoulins also has exclusive in-match gameplay. Friendly Haavk units will remain neutral toward Squad Desmoulins (excluding Hudson units); Results are calculated based on operation performance, earning Performance Points. Increasing your Performance Rank grants exclusive Director's supplies and limited appearances. Director's Reward Crates have a chance to contain limited red-quality collectibles. Completing Director's and Adjutant's to-do missions grants Performance Points; complete all missions to earn an exclusive Medal of Honor. Unlike Fiery Owl Hunt, in this Polaris Patrol event, G.T.I. Operators can also earn Performance Points by defeating Squad Desmoulins in a match. G.T.I. Operators who defeat Desmoulins have a chance to find limited red-quality collectibles in his mezzanine. Identity Requirements Security Director Desmoulins: Complete the Desmoulins File to unlock the Desmoulins identity. Entering as Desmoulins requires spending a Security Director's Work Badge. Desmoulins can enter solo or team up with an Adjutant. Adjutant: Adjutants include the Heavy Guard and Comms Guard, unlocked by default, requiring no Security Director's Work Badge to enter. A Desmoulins must be present in the squad for an Adjutant to enter. Squad Desmoulins Loadouts: Can manually configure loadouts or use Gear Tickets and exclusive Custom Gear Tickets. Special access: Desmoulins can use the executive elevator and its exclusive extraction point in the Space City garden. After the G.T.I. faction kills Desmoulins, they can pick up his special Access Card in the mezzanine sector to use the aforementioned exclusive access. Security Director's Work Badges can be purchased from the Supply Station for 250,000 Tekniq Alloys each. You can initially purchase 4, with one additional purchase slot restored every 21 hours, up to a maximum of 8 stored. Desmoulin's Squad Ability Overview Security Director - Anais Desmoulins Tactical Gear: Neural-Controlled Vehicle Deploys and controls a Haavk cutting-edge Neural-Controlled Vehicle for remote combat operations. The vehicle is equipped with a multi-function Weapon Station, featuring combat modules such as an MG, Grenade Launcher, Threat Imaging System, and Seeker Bomb Vehicle. Tactical Gear: Threat Imaging System Activates her imaging system to scan and mark nearby threats, and share target data with squadmates. While active, gains increased handling and ADS movement speed based on her equipped weapon, along with additional buffs. When in a vehicle, she can lock onto enemy targets, enabling lock-on for certain vehicle weapons. Tactical Gear: Seeker Bomb Vehicle Deploys a Seeker Bomb Vehicle that moves forward, searching for enemies. Upon detecting a target, it automatically locks on, pursues the target, and detonates after a short delay. Weakness Analysis Desmoulins applies a lasting Weakness effect to enemies hit. Affected targets have reduced armor repair speed and slower use of certain medical items, increasing recovery time. If a target enters the Dying state, their Bleed Rate increases and their mobility while Downed is reduced. Adjutant - Athos Leal Tactical Gear: Remote Bomb Throws a remote bomb that can be manually detonated after attaching, or detonates automatically after a longer delay. It can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, greatly extending the automatic detonation timer while attached. Tactical Gear: Smoke Grenade Fires a smoke grenade that bursts on impact. The grenade can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, continuously releasing smoke from the attachment point for a set duration. Operator Trait: Haavk Elite Drags allies to safety. When the Adjutant is near Desmoulins or the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, direct damage dealt by either one to an enemy operator briefly increases the Adjutant's movement speed. Adjutant - Aramis Orgueil Tactical Gear: Flare Fires a flare that hovers in place after traveling a set distance, periodically scanning for enemy operators. The flare can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle and periodically scan from the attachment point. Tactical Gear: Airburst Grenade Fires an airburst grenade that detonates after a fixed delay, dealing damage. The grenade can attach to the Neural-Controlled Vehicle without changing its detonation delay. Operator Trait: Haavk Elite Drags allies to safety. When the Adjutant is near Desmoulins or the Neural-Controlled Vehicle, direct damage dealt by either one to an enemy operator briefly increases the Adjutant's movement speed. Available Operations and Difficulty Normal Operation: Space City - Normal, AZ3 - Normal; Hard Operation: Space City - Hard. Gameplay Rewards Increasing your Performance Rank grants rewards upon leveling up, with exclusive rewards including: Desmoulins Reward Crate: Chance to obtain the red-quality Petite Madame or red-quality Requin Model; once both Petite Madame and Requin Model are collected, they can be assembled into the Petite Madame - Requin Model. The Petite Madame - Requin Model can be placed in your EDC Tool Kit and brought into matches; Desmoulins Exclusive Weapon Appearance: [M700 Sniper Rifle] - Serenity; M700 Sniper Rifle Exclusive Attachment: HVK Whirlwind Enhanced Gas Block: Craftable once Polaris Patrol reaches the Hunter stage, limited to 10 per week; Desmoulins Exclusive Cosmetic Rewards: Desmoulins Avatar, Spray Paint, Calling Card, and Gesture; Defeating a player-controlled Desmoulins allows you to search the Desmoulins Mezzanine , which has a chance to drop the exclusive collectibles Petite Madame or Requin Model; Completing challenge missions grants exclusive challenge rewards: a substantial amount of Performance Points to quickly boost your Performance Rank, ample combat supplies, and unique Custom Gear Tickets. Mission Overview By decoding the special neural frequency band used by Haavk Security Director Anais Desmoulins, we have successfully simulated her neural device's perspective and behavioral patterns, hoping that intensive, in-depth simulation will help us reverse-engineer the story behind Polaris Patrol... Desmoulins File: Sealed within the protection of a Safe Box, Desmoulins' cherished personal memories slowly unfold. What secrets lie hidden in the past she watches over? Explore the five memories within the box—sync, feel, and understand. Unlocked at Operations Level 33, featuring five mission branches where players must choose and complete three. After completing the Desmoulins File, you'll unlock the Desmoulins identity option in Polaris Patrol mode, as well as access to Director's To-Do tasks in Polaris Challenge. Polaris Challenge: The main missions in this mode include both Director's To-Do and Adjutant's To-Do tasks. Select the corresponding identity to complete the relevant challenges. By completing these challenges, experience a story unfolding within the Haavk workplace, and earn exclusive operator voice line rewards. Private Mailbox: We have obtained access to Desmoulins' Haavk corporate email account. As you progress through Polaris Challenge and raise your Performance Rank, you'll continuously receive various emails from Desmoulins' social network. Put yourself in her shoes and consider: if you held a position of power like Ms. Anais Desmoulins, how would your every word and action deeply affect your friends, enemies, and even family... Exclusive Custom Gear Tickets Desmoulins Spec Ops Gear Ticket (Limited-Time) Firepower: Added SR-25 Marksman Rifle, AR57 Assault Rifle; Balanced: Added RM277 Assault Rifle, K437 Assault Rifle. Desmoulins Elite Gear Ticket (Limited-Time) [600,000 Combat Readiness Value] Firepower: Added PKM Light Machine Gun, QJB201 Light Machine Gun; Balanced: Added AKM Assault Rifle, M249 Light Machine Gun. Security Elite Gear Ticket (Limited-Time) [600,000 Combat Readiness Value] Firepower: Added SCAR-H Battle Rifle, AKM Assault Rifle; Balanced: Added M4A1 Assault Rifle, MCX-LT Assault Rifle. Security Standard Gear Ticket (Limited-Time) Firepower: Added AKM Assault Rifle, AK-12 Assault Rifle; Balanced: Added S12K Shotgun, Vityaz Submachine Gun. OPERATIONS NEW GAMEPLAY - FISHING Unlock Requirements: Operations level 17; Layali Grove - Easy, find fishing enthusiast Joe Reed; Fishable Maps: Zero Dam - Easy, Layali Grove - Easy, AZ3 - Easy Loadout & Entry: Equip fishing rods, bait, and other fishing gear in your EDC Tool Kit; unlock the Float Fishing Rod and Lure Rod (different rods catch different fish); purchase fishing gear at the Fishing Store, and assemble your own custom fishing rod in the Fishing Modify screen. In-Match: Reach the vicinity of a fishable body of water; use the EDC Tool Kit wheel to switch to your fishing rod and cast; with the Float Fishing Rod, reel in quickly once the float fully sinks below the surface; with the Lure Rod, watch the line tension (White = Low, Yellow = Medium, Red = High) and reel against the fish's struggle direction — excessive tension snaps the line, so release some to reduce it. Reel the fish to shore to catch it. Fishing Level and Skill: Catching fish grants Fishing EXP, which increases your Fishing Level; at certain Fishing Levels, find Joe Reed to complete an assessment and raise your Fishing Level Certification; higher certification unlocks more advanced rods, lines, and bait for rarer fish. Gallery Records: Fish caught in-match unlock and update Gallery records, tracking the highest rarity, and max/min length and weight per species — whether a fish is extracted or sold does not affect its Gallery data. Fishing Exclusive Expansion Crate: After unlocking the fishing system via Joe Reed's mail, this crate auto-equips to your Stash (without using existing expansion slots), and fishing-related items/catches are prioritized into it. OPERATIONS NEW MODE - 1V1 Event Period: Available after the Mid-Season Update Event Description: Bring your gear into battle and choose your battlefield in a 1v1 standoff! Zero gear consumption throughout, so fight with everything you've got and claim your victory! NEW AMMO .45 ACP Super Permanent Ammo AP Ammo with Level 5 penetration; Damage Multiplier 0.85x; Armor Penetration Multiplier 1x; Armor Damage Multiplier vs Level 1-6 armor: 1.1x across the board. 4.6X30mm CT Season Limited Ammo Specialized ammunition designed to damage limbs at the cost of armor penetration. Level 0 penetration; Deals 1.85x limb damage; Reduces fire rate by 15% when loaded; Adds random ADS spread and reduces recoil control when loaded; Cannot be stored in a Safe Box. 4.6X30mm FMJ ST Season Limited Ammo Pointed ammo, Level 4 penetration; Headshot damage 1.25x; Chest damage 1.25x; Abdomen damage 0.9x; Limb damage 0.9x. 4.6X30mm AP ST Season Limited Ammo Pointed ammo, Level 5 penetration; Headshot damage 1.25x; Chest damage 1.25x; Abdomen damage 0.9x; Limb damage 0.9x. 12 Gauge Dart Season Limited Ammo Dart-shaped projectiles that leave enemies bleeding when they strike and deal damage. Level 3 penetration; Damage multiplier 0.85x; Adds lacerating trauma on hit; Targets with lacerating trauma take increased damage while moving at high speed. NEW PERMANENT ATTACHMENTS APX Hybrid Sight — Handling -4; Moderate Optical Zoom. NEW LIMITED-TIME HAAVK WEAPON ATTACHMENTS M700 HVK Whirlwind Frame System Operations Control -4, Stability +4, Accuracy -8, adds Modification Slots, Semi-Auto Burst Fire. Warfare Same stat profile M700 HVK Whirlwind Enhanced Gas Block Operations Control - 4; Handling -2; Stability +2; Full Auto, Limb Damage Penalty, Abdomen Damage Penalty. Warfare Control - 4; Handling -2; Stability +2; Full Auto, Limb Damage Penalty, Torso Damage Penalty. QJB201 HVK Windrage Feed Kit Operations Control +13; Stability +4; Accuracy -20; consecutive shots increase fire rate. Warfare Control +13; Handling +2; Stability +4; Accuracy -20; consecutive shots increase fire rate. 93R HVK Weasel SMG Kit Operations Range +10m; Control +5; Handling +4; Stability +3; Accuracy -8; Full Auto. Warfare: Range +7m; Control +4; Handling +3; Stability +3; Accuracy -12; Full Auto. NEW WEAPONS MDR Assault Rifle, using 7.62x51mm caliber ammo; Thompson SMG, using .45 caliber ammo. NEW VEHICLES Amphibious LSV SEASON MISSION UPDATE S10 SEASON MISSION RESET All progress on Season 10 missions will be completely reset and cleared. Any Ultimate Safe Box Season Access from previous seasons, along with any Safe Box Trial Cards (used or not), will expire and become invalid. S11 SEASON MISSION UPDATE Season 11 kicks off with a brand-new mission line for operators to challenge. S11 MISSION LOAD REDUCTION (SHORT SEASON EXCLUSIVE) Reduced star requirements for Phase Two main missions; Reduced Phase Two combat missions; Phase Two side missions unlock earlier, offering more optional missions; Phase Three removes the Tide Prison mission, and side missions unlock earlier; Reduced submission count required for Collectors: 1 submission needed for Ultimate Safe Box Season Access, 5 submissions needed for Ultimate Safe Box Season Deluxe Collection Appearance. GAMEPLAY TUNING ALL MODES - CHARACTER PERSPECTIVE & CONTROL OPTIMIZATIONS Added Drag Rescue: You can drag the rescued teammate while rescuing them. In Operations mode, only the Desmoulins Squad has Drag Rescue enabled by default; in Warfare mode, all operators can use Drag Rescue, with the default interact key set to H, which can be customized. Added voiceprint transparency adjustment for mobile devices, available in the custom control settings screen. Added a "Maintain Movement in Backpack/Map Screen" setting for mobile devices, which allows you to keep moving while in the backpack or map screen when enabled. OPERATIONS AZ3 Optimization: Improved how vegetation in the Old Academy of Sciences affects combat. Space City Optimization: 15 minutes after the match starts, a random Switch Point will appear in either the Black Chamber or Buoyancy Lab. Combined with the original Switch Points in the Test Range and Centrifuge Facility, there will be a total of three Switch Points; pulling any two of them will activate the Helicopter Extraction Point; Adjusted the Switch Point location in the Test Range; Added an exclusive extraction point and executive elevator for Squad Desmoulins. After the G.T.I. faction kills player Desmoulins, they can obtain his special Access Card in his mezzanine to use his exclusive extraction point. Adjusted certain unbalanced positions in Centrifuge Facility. Adjusted the positions of certain covers at the Dock. In-match Map Signal Jamming Zone Optimization: Opened the blocked-off area at Layali Grove - Radar Station. Switch Points and Extraction Points can now be marked within the signal jamming zones on all maps. WARFARE Free Build: Added new buildable fortification - Vulcan Cannon; the bases of Coastal Artillery, AA Guns, and Vulcan Cannons in freely built fortifications can now be destroyed; Fixed Weapon Adjustments: Fixed an issue where the Vulcan Cannon experienced rotation stuttering in certain situations; fixed an issue where the omnidirectional Coastal Artillery experienced rotation stuttering in certain situations; improved the depression angle of the Coastal Artillery, now adjusted to -15°. Ascension A/D: Added an automatic Vulcan Cannon at the Defender's base in Sector B. Once the Attacker captures Sector B, the automatic Vulcan Cannon transfers to the Attacker's control. Added Ace Mark to Victory Unite mode: Players with standout contributions in a match can receive a corresponding in-match mark. Aftershock: Reduced camera shake effects caused by minor and moderate earthquakes; Coliseum - A/D: Adjusted the capture area for Objective A; fixed an issue where the countdown was too short when the Defender extracted from Sector A to Sector B; adjusted the redeploy positions at Objectives B, C, and D; adjusted the boundary line of Sector C; adjusted the attackers' vehicle deployment position in Sector D. Trainwreck - King of the Hill: Adjusted the redeploy positions at Sector B and Sector C. Cracked - A/D Drill: Fixed an issue where deploying next to a teammate would incorrectly show an insufficient space warning; A/D & VICTORY UNITE VEHICLE DEPLOYMENT ADJUSTMENTS Cyclone: Removed the Combat Speedboat that spawns at low troop force in Sector A, removed the AAV Amphibious Armored Vehicle that spawns at low troop force in Sector B, and removed the AAV Amphibious Armored Vehicle that spawns at low troop force in Sector E; added Amphibious LSV spawns at low troop force in Sectors A, B, and E; Fault: Removed the Assault Vehicle and ORV that spawn in Sector A, added Amphibious LSV; Ascension: Changed the deployment location of the LAV-AA in Sector A to dynamic deployment. KING OF THE HILL VEHICLE DEPLOYMENT ADJUSTMENTS Ascension: Removed the Assault Vehicle from base vehicle deployment, added Amphibious LSV, and added an Amphibious LSV that spawns after capturing the objective; Fault: Removed the Assault Vehicle from base vehicle deployment, added Amphibious LSV, and added an Amphibious LSV that spawns after capturing the objective; Akh Canal: Added an Amphibious LSV that spawns after capturing the objective. VEHICLE MODIFICATION FUNCTION ADJUSTMENTS Added modified vehicle variant: Amphibious LSV — now divided into Assault, Mortar, and Rocket Launcher variants. The Amphibious LSV can spend points during combat to unlock the Mortar and Rocket Launcher variants through modification. Once unlocked with points, the unlocked Amphibious LSV variants can be deployed or airdropped directly. Primary weapon ammo for Amphibious LSV variants can be replenished at supply stations by spending points, and cannot be automatically replenished via the Vehicle Supply Station. *We will closely monitor operator feedback on the gameplay performance and combat feedback of the Amphibious LSV and its variants across different maps, and will deploy the Amphibious LSV to more maps in the future based on operators' combat needs. SYSTEM OPTIMIZATION ALL MODES Tutorial: Added system gameplay tutorial; and improved the interactive experience of PC tutorials. Collection Screen Optimization: Improved tab layout; added a Vehicle Appearance tab, allowing you to adjust vehicle appearances in the Collectibles screen; Added Favorites function, pinning owned items to the top of the display; Added text search to quickly locate target items; improved the existing random appearance function, now allowing free selection between Random Favorited Appearance and Random Owned Appearance; Added Random Charm, Random Vehicle Appearance, Random Safe Box Appearance, and Random Death Box Appearance functions. New Match Ratings: Coup — in Victory Unite mode, defeat the enemy faction's Commander 10 times in a single match; Added a fishing match rating to Operations, unlocked by catching certain rare fish. New Achievements: Super Director (Polaris Patrol — a Desmoulins Squad member defeats at least 12 operators solo in a single match); Speed Hunter (any normal/hard Operations match — knock down 6 enemy operators within 30 seconds, excluding Operation Blackout); All-Round Squad (Victory Unite — most kills, most rescues, most objective captures, and most vehicle score); Boss Hunt (4 tiers — cumulative "Coup" rating 10/50/100/200 times); Fishing Journey (4 tiers — reach Fishing Level Certification of Advanced, Veteran, Master, and Grandmaster). MandelBrick: Each type of MandelBrick has a holding cap of 1000. If your current holdings exceed the cap, the excess will not be deducted, but you will be unable to obtain more until it drops below the cap. OPERATIONS New Permanent Collectibles: Red Quality: Ayur Coffee Machine, Fishmoon Finial; Gold Quality: Dancing Girl Charm; Blue Quality: Medical Stapler, Nameless Poetry Collection, Evidence Disc. Added high-value item inspection: Impressionist Painting, Buoyancy Compensator. Gear Ticket Update: Season Mission Custom Gear Ticket: Option 1 removed SR-25 Marksman Rifle and SVCH Marksman Rifle, added MK4 Submachine Gun and Thompson SMG; Option 2 removed AR57 Assault Rifle, added MDR Assault Rifle. Spec Ops Gear Ticket: Balanced removed ASh-12 Battle Rifle, added AR57 Assault Rifle; Survival removed SVCH Marksman Rifle, added MDR Assault Rifle; Firepower removed AR57 Assault Rifle, added M700 Sniper Rifle & 93R Set combo. Elite Gear Ticket: Balanced removed RM277 Assault Rifle and P90 Submachine Gun, added MK4 Submachine Gun. Standard Gear Ticket: Balanced removed SG552 Assault Rifle, added Thompson SMG. EDC Tool Kit: Reaching Operations Level 17 and obtaining at least one "Portable Tool" type item unlocks the EDC Tool Kit function. Items placed in it cannot be taken out or dropped mid-match, do not count toward Entry Loadout Value, can only be placed/removed outside matches, and will not drop or be lost on a failed extraction. Currently supported EDC items: Golden Soccer Ball, Iridescent Soccer Ball, Ahsarah Card Box (can no longer be brought into matches through standard means such as the Safe Box), Drone, Fishing Rod, and Petite Madame - Requin Model. More items will be added over time. Loadout Screen Seasonal Ammo Optimization: When season-limited ammo is removed, the Loadout Screen will hide ammo types you do not own; if the ammo still exists in your Stash, it will not be hidden and remaining rounds can still be added. Fishing: Reaching Operations Level 17 and completing the fishing mission to obtain a fishing rod unlocks the Fishing function. Auction House: Added a convenient feature that directly sells attachments below a certain per-slot value to the Supply Station when selling a full weapon. Leaderboard: Fixed an issue where the Leaderboard did not display accurate information. WARFARE Added a "Report/Add Friend" button to the in-match scoreboard in Warfare; Victory Unite Pre-Selected Commander: players can opt in to run for Commander in the lobby and automatically enter the Commander election phase. Matchmaking will prioritize ensuring both sides have a pre-selected Commander candidate, which may slightly increase matchmaking time; New Mode: Free Battlefield: Allows players to freely create rooms under Victory Unite rules; Victory Unite Mode Vehicle Deployment Request: Deploying a vehicle requires Commander approval. The Commander, top-eight historical seasonal Vehicle KPM players, or Gold vehicle proficiency-rated players can deploy directly without this restriction; unanswered requests are auto-approved. Victory Unite Mode Unlock Condition Adjustment: Reaching Colonel in the Grade will permanently unlock Victory Unite mode. WEAPON BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS AND OPTIMIZATIONS BOTH MODES - M250 LMG Significantly increased Recoil for the M250 LMG on mobile devices. ↓ OPERATIONS K437 Assault Rifle: K437 Lancer Long Barrel Combo: Range and Muzzle Velocity +30% → +50% ↑; Armor Penetration Specialization 32 → 35 ↑. M14 Marksman Rifle: M14 30-Round Mag: Handling -8 → -4 ↑. M14 50-Round Drum Mag: Handling -12 → -6 ↑. M82 Sniper Rifle: Crocodile Barrel Combo: Handling +8 → +11 ↑. AMR-HT Hollow Stock: Handling +4 → +8 ↑. WARFARE K437 Assault Rifle: K437 Lancer Long Barrel Combo: Range and Muzzle Velocity +15% → +25% ↑. M82 Sniper Rifle: Crocodile Barrel Combo: Handling +8 → +10 ↑. AMR-HT Hollow Stock: Handling +3 → +7 ↑. WEAPON & COMBAT BUG FIXES AND OPTIMIZATIONS Added a movement accuracy penalty when aiming down sights with sniper rifles in Operations mode: firing while stationary has no bloom, but any movement causes significant spread. Added a Hip Fire Crosshair Customization system: you can now customize your hip fire crosshair and share it via a share code. Optimized post-fire recovery for bolt-action SRs: reduced the long recovery time after firing a bolt-action SR, allowing players to transition into sprinting more smoothly. Improved the firing animations for the M1911 and Desert Eagle. OPERATOR BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS Developer's Note: This update focuses on several Support operators. Currently, in certain scenarios, some Support operators' Gadget deployment is too slow, coverage falls behind their squadmates, and duration is inconsistent. This round of changes focuses on improving feel, range, and duration. We hope you enjoy the changes! RECON OPERATOR - HACKCLAW Operations Signal Decoder: Cooldown 120s → 90s ↑. SUPPORT OPERATOR - VLINDER All Modes Med Drones: No longer attaches to squadmates encountered while pathfinding. Flutter Rescue UAVs: Improved deployment feel and shortened deployment time ↑; Rescue UAV pathfinding speed 10 m/s → 15 m/s ↑. Windmill Smoke Grenade: S moke flight speed increased, 20 m/s → 22 m/s ↑. Operations Flutter Rescue UAVs: UAV Rescue now heals the rescued player for more HP: 20 → 50 ↑. SUPPORT OPERATOR - TOXIK All Modes Adreno-Boost: Buff Range 13m → 20m ↑; Load buff duration 12s → 25s ↑. Warfare Adreno-Boost: Buff Range 13m → 20m ↑. Blinding Gas: Blinding effect now has a delayed onset — blindness occurs 1.5 seconds after entering smoke. ↓ SUPPORT OPERATOR - STINGER All Modes Hive-Tech Pistol: Initial ammo 1 → 3 ↑; Pain Relief buff duration 20s → 25s ↑. ENGINEER OPERATOR - N-TWO All Modes Cryo-Flask: The low-temperature zone can now be cleared by explosions. Can now be replenished via Ammo Crates, and can no longer be replenished through charging. OPERATOR-RELATED BUG FIXES & OPTIMIZATIONS Adjusted damage for Flashbang and Stun-type gadgets from 1 to 0.01. Added deployment sound effects for Shepherd's Sonic Trap, improving audio recognition feedback. Added deployment sound effects for Gizmo's T.I.M (Tenacious Interception Module), improving audio recognition feedback. HARDWARE SPECIFICATIONS SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK Operators are welcome to contact us through the following channels: Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/garenadeltaforce/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/garena.deltaforce/ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@GarenaDFSMP TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@garenadeltaforce Discord: https://discord.com/invite/b7WmrQWDq9 Thank you again, Operators, for joining Delta Force! Wishing everyone a happy new season! Garena Delta Force Team

title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
text: \CacheFixed various gaps in map.Fixed a wallbang spot on B site.Added a missing competitive CT spawn point.Added additional T spawn points.\Reworked CSPlayerCamera:Renamed it to CustomPlayerCamera.Added GetPlayer, GetMode, SetMode, and SetFollowConfig.Deprecated IsEnabled, SetEnabled, and SetIsControllingAngles.Added an 'observable' property to custom_hud_layout that controls whether an observer sees the UI as the spectated player sees it. Defaults to false.Fixed several bugs related to stale custom_hud_layout state when changing spectator targets.Added top-level custom_hud_layout classes driven by client state:HUD_BUYMENU_VISIBLEHUD_SCOREBOARD_VISIBLEcustom_hud_layout now always draws on top of the base HUD.\Chat is now encrypted in demo files using the same rules as CS:GO :Team chat is no longer readable when playing back demo files.Global chat is only readable in demo files when played back via the in-game watch UI.

title: Champions Shanghai Opening Day
text: OPENING DAY // CHAMPIONS SHANGHAI Champions Shanghai starts way before the first bullet is fired. Forget what you know about Opening Day. This year we’re taking our city-wide collision of culture, community, and competition in China directly to your screen, no matter where you are in the world. If you aren’t dialed in from the very first minute on September 24 at 1:00am PDT (4:00pm CST), you’re missing out on the most ambitious, chaotic, and beautiful Champions opening we’ve ever built. WHAT TO EXPECT This year’s opening day is bigger than any single stage, so we’re taking you beyond the arena. Opening Day Segments : Segments all across a city that lives and breathes VALORANT Champions. Join us at Pop Mart, Hai Di Lao, DOE, Artist Alley, the VALORANT Concept PC Bang, and on the streets of Shanghai. MEET THE TALENT Hosts & Creators: TenZ Sacy TcK MeL Loupiote Spicyuuu SiuFatBB HOW TO WATCH Mark your calendars and be there before the starting bell. trust. Date : September 24 Start Time : 1:00am PDT, 4:00pm CST Where to Watch : Tune in via the official VALORANT channels. It’s the biggest stage. The biggest event. The biggest VALORANT Champions celebration in history. We’ll see you in Shanghai.
